verdict.rationale: Casium publishes a blog guide to International Entrepreneur Parole that says it covers eligibility criteria and the application process, so the pathway is at least documented in first-party content. The evidence does not show Casium offering or filing IER parole as a service, and no investment thresholds are quoted. Missing for 10: explicit statement that Casium offers or handles IER parole cases, stated qualifying-investment and grant thresholds, any corroboration beyond a single blog intro line.

support.subject: As a founder, the International Entrepreneur Rule (parole) is documented as an offered pathway, with its qualifying-investment thresholds stated

citations.quote: This article aims to help you understand its eligibility criteria, application process, benefits, and criticisms.
